spans.s:
ind.
1 Here, in this place.
2 Now, at this time.

r. 1st cl. (-ङ) ईहङ् (ईहते)
To endeavour, to aim or attempt.
With सम् prefixed,
to wish, to desire.

f. (-हा)
1 Wish, desire.
2 Effort, exertion.
E.
ईह to desire. अङ् and टाप् affs.

m. (-लः)
This life.
E.
इह and काल time.

m. (-कः)
This life, this world.
E.
इह and लोक world.

ind.
Here and there, in this world and in the next.
E.
इह here, अमूत्र there or in that.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Performing, undertaking.
E.
ईह to make effort, शानच् aff.

ind.
Diligently, energetically, by or with labour or exertion.
E.
तसि substituted for the regular case.

m. (-गः)
1 A wolf.
2 A division of the drama.
E.
ईहा wish, and मृग a deer.

mfn. (-र्थी-थिनी-र्थि)
1 Aiming at any object.
2 Seeking wealth.
E.
ईह to seek, अर्थ wealth, इनि aff.

m. (-कः)
A wolf.
E.
ईहा and वृक a wolf.
